original_bug_mechanism: Resource-initiated blockwise responses advertise the maximum size instead of the smaller resource-selected size.
synthetic_bug_mechanism: The engine takes the generated payload length as the block size instead of respecting the resource continuation boundary.
distinctness: The original upstream fix is retained. The engine takes the generated payload length as the block size instead of respecting the resource continuation boundary.
oracle: The unchanged capped_payload regression supplies 32 bytes with a 16-byte continuation boundary; the response must advertise and contain 16 bytes. Existing controls must pass.
realism: Confusing generated bytes with the resource-requested chunk size is a plausible error when both lengths are in scope.
